resources.string: Unlock your phone with your irises.
Iris unlock when screen turns on
Unlock your phone with your irises as soon as the screen turns on, without swiping first.
When you unlock with iris recognition, stay on the Lock screen until you swipe.
Features that use irises will be turned off.
Hold your phone farther away from your face and try again.
The iris sensor is not responding. Try again later.
If this keeps happening, restart your phone.
Use face and iris recognition together for better accuracy and security.
Combine face and iris scanning for better results.
Your face and irises have been registered.
"If you're using face or iris authentication in apps, you'll need to register your face or irises again to sign in to those apps."
Use irises and face recognition together for safe, convenient unlocking and verification.
Unlock your phone using combined face and iris scanning.
Unlock your phone with Intelligent Scan as soon as the screen turns on, without swiping first.
When you unlock with Intelligent Scan, stay on the Lock screen until you swipe.
Intelligent Scan is turned off automatically when both Face and Iris are turned off.
Face and Iris turned off automatically when Intelligent Scan turned off.
Before you can register your irises, you need to set a secure screen lock (pattern, PIN, or password).
Before you can register your face and irises, you need to set a secure screen lock (pattern, PIN, or password).
